title: Two Questions on $G$-harmonic Tuples
summary: An $n$-tuple of positive integers is $G$-harmonic if there are subgroups of $G$ having those indices whose cosets can be chosen pairwise disjoint, and $\mathbb{Z}$-harmonic if there are pairwise disjoint residue classes with those moduli. Ginosar asked whether every $G$-harmonic tuple is $\mathbb{Z}$-harmonic. Margolis and Schnabel proved this for tuples of length at most $4$, and analysed a particular family of length-$5$ tuples that would yield a counterexample if any member were $G$-harmonic.
